Short title and Commencement

ACT IV OF 1986
CRIMINAL LAW
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 1986
ACT IV OF 1986
An Act further to amend the Pakistan
Penal Code and the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 5th November, 1986]
The following Act of Majhs-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 29th October, 1988 and is hereby published for
general information:-
1. Short title and Commencement.-------(1) This Act may be called the
Criminal Law (Amendment) Act, 1986.
(2) It shall come into force at once.

Amendment of section 499, Act XLV of 1860

[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary,
Part I, 5th November, 1986]
The following Act of Majhs-e-Shoora (Parliament) received the
assent of the President on the 29th October, 1988 and is hereby published for
general information:-
2. Amendment of section 499, Act XLV of 1860.-----In Pakistan Penal Code (Act XLV of
1860) .
(a) in section 499, for .the colon after the word
"person" a full stop shall be substituted and the proviso shall be
omitted, and
(b) in section 500, for the colon after the word
"both". a full stop shall be substituted and the proviso shall be
omitted.
